fusions.name: Hopping Rivet
fusions.desc: Flicks a rivet that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then hops to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hop dealing 50% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Floor-Shaking Drop
fusions.desc: Drops your full weight onto the ground, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Landing Brace
fusions.desc: You hop 3 tiles forward and land braced, raising your armour by 25% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Height Into Weight
fusions.desc: Each time you cover enough ground, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
